title: NavTrust: Benchmarking Trustworthiness for Embodied Navigation

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust sets a universal standard for AI trust in navigation, ensuring consistent, reliable performance across all environments.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking reveals flaws in NavTrust’s assumptions—real-world navigation requires adaptability, not just static metrics.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust integrates ISO/IEC 23894 protocols, ensuring transparency and accountability in AI decision-making during navigation.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking exposes AI biases and edge-case failures—NavTrust ignores these, risking deployment in critical scenarios.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Trust without transparency is just an illusion—benchmarking is the only path to true, scalable trust in embodied AI.
